mapper.sql: FROM cm_content_post cp INNER JOIN cm_monitor_target_content mtc ON mtc.content_id = cp.content_id AND mtc.status = 'active' AND mtc.del_flag = '0' INNER JOIN cm_monitor_target mt ON mt.target_id = mtc.target_id AND mt.status = 'active' AND mt.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT cp.*
WHERE cp.content_id = #{contentId} AND cp.del_flag = '0' LIMIT 1
